lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least six vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin. The centroids follow a semi-regular spacing pattern vertically within each column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating high-contrast nodes typical of a structural grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and local shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately six low-intensity, high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, though boundaries are softened by water column turbidity.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, circular white spots that are significantly smaller in diameter and more tightly packed than the primary lateral flank blobs.
